content: Migrating Compose Navigation to Kotlin Serialization requires replacing string routes with @Serializable classes/objects. Instead of NavArgument, define properties in the data class. Use the composable<T> {} builder. Get arguments via backStackEntry.toRoute<T>() or savedStateHandle.toRoute<T>(). Update navigation calls from string URIs to passing instances of the data class, e.g., navController.navigate(Profile(id = "123")).
